snippet.title: NightRunner | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the Playtest: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247260/NightRunner

NightRunner mixes coop horde survival with PVE extraction mechanics, dungeon exploration, and tower defense systems. Inspired by Killing Floor and CoD Zombies (Tranzit), it delivers intense combat, strategic survival, and high-risk, high-reward gameplay.

Learn more: https://play.nightrunnergame.com/

Follow us on:
https://discord.gg/TEJMepsMgn
https://x.com/PlayNightrunner
